subject: Social Media
title: Sponsored Content Deception
description: A micro-lesson that makes Sponsored Content Deception usable.

hook.text: She raves about a moisturizer. It feels genuine. In tiny text: #ad. You missed it. That was the plan.

buildup.text: The FTC requires disclosure of paid partnerships. Many influencers bury it or skip it entirely.

discovery.text: Studies show disclosed ads lose 25% of persuasive power. The incentive to hide disclosure is enormous.

twist.text: Audiences say they hate undisclosed ads. But their purchase behavior doesn't reflect it. They still buy.

climax.text: Platforms added automatic 'Paid Partnership' labels. Creators resisted—visible labels hurt engagement.

punchline.text: Transparency costs money. That's why it's rare.

quiz.question: Why do some influencers hide ad disclosures?
options: Disclosed ads lose about 25% of persuasive power
